turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Explain that before anything else.
Can I ask you something, professional to professional?
No. You can answer my question. Why did my son learn about a zero from his phone before anyone picked up a telephone to call me?
How should I handle parents like you? What actually works on someone like you?
You want me to tell you how to manage me? Documents work, Hale, and so far you've shown me none. Withdraw the zero, or tell me what you actually have.
